title: CI: `experiments/` exclusion is bypassed on direct pushes to main; `docs-changed`/`mjs-changed` ignore the folder exclusion
body:
`experiments/` is deliberately excluded from code-change detection, but that exclusion is bypassed on every direct push to `main`. A commit touching only `experiments/` runs the full test suite, coverage, and both e2e legs.

Measured, not inferred: commit `ff38e2ab` added six files, all under `experiments/`, and produced run [30118611467](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/30118611467):

| Job | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Detect Changes | success |
| Version Modification Check | **skipped** |
| Create Changelog PR | **skipped** |
| Self-Hosting Evidence Check | **skipped** |
| Changelog Fragment Check | **skipped** |
| Docker Image Build & Runtime Check | **skipped** |
| Secrets Scan | ran |
| Lint and Format Check | ran |
| Code Coverage | ran |
| Test (ubuntu-latest) | ran |
| E2E Tests (local web app) | ran |
| E2E Tests (agent CLI ↔ formal-ai) | ran |

The change-gated jobs behaved correctly — the exclusion works. The rest ran anyway.

## Cause

`scripts/detect-code-changes.rs:155` excludes the folder from `any-code-changed`:

```rust
let excluded_folders = ["changelog.d/", "docs/", "experiments/", "examples/"];
```

But every gated `if:` in `.github/workflows/release.yml` begins with an unconditional push clause, e.g. `:235-241`:

```yaml
if: |
  !cancelled() && (
    github.event_name == 'push' ||
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
    needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
    …
  )
```

`github.event_name == 'push'` short-circuits before any `detect-changes` output is consulted. So the exclusion applies to pull requests and is inert on pushes to `main` — exactly where throwaway reproduction scripts are most likely to be committed directly.

There is also a second, narrower inconsistency. `docs-changed` and `mjs-changed` are computed by file extension alone (`detect-code-changes.rs:196-201`) and never consult `excluded_folders`:

```rust
let mjs_changed = changed_files.iter().any(|f| has_extension(f, "mjs"));
let docs_changed = changed_files.iter().any(|f| has_extension(f, "md"));
```

So `experiments/foo.md` sets `docs-changed=true` and triggers the two jobs gated on it, despite living in an excluded folder. (`mjs-changed` is computed but never consumed by any job, which is worth either wiring up or deleting.)

I worked around this while committing `ff38e2ab` by keeping that directory free of `.md` and `.mjs` — `README.txt` instead of `README.md`. That workaround should not be necessary and will not survive contact with the next contributor.

## Why it matters

The stated intent is explicit — `.github/workflows/release.yml:374-375`:

> `experiments/` is deliberately excluded: those are throwaway reproduction scripts, not shipped code.

Running the full suite on a pure-experiments commit costs CI minutes for no signal, and — worse — makes a green check on such a commit look like it validated something. It also means an unrelated flaky failure can block a commit that touched no shipped code.

## Options

1. **`paths-ignore` at the workflow trigger.** Add to `on: push:` — `experiments/**`, `dev/log/**`, `docs/case-studies/**`. Simplest, and matches the exclusions already used by the shellcheck selector (`release.yml:381`) and `detect-code-changes.rs:155`. Risk: it is a *second* place the exclusion list lives, so the two can drift.
2. **Drop the unconditional `github.event_name == 'push'` clause** so `detect-changes` outputs govern pushes exactly as they govern PRs. Keeps one source of truth, but changes behaviour for every job and needs care — some jobs may legitimately need to run on every push (release/versioning paths in particular).
3. **Make `docs-changed` / `mjs-changed` respect `excluded_folders`**, independent of 1 or 2. Small, safe, removes the `.md`/`.txt` workaround.

Option 3 is worth doing regardless. The choice between 1 and 2 is a maintainer call about whether pushes to `main` should ever be able to skip the suite; I have not changed either.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A commit touching only `experiments/` (including `.md` and `.mjs` files) does not run the test suite, coverage, or e2e jobs on a direct push to `main`.
- [ ] The same holds for `dev/log/**` and `docs/case-studies/**`.
- [ ] The exclusion list has one authoritative definition, or drift between copies is caught by a test.
- [ ] `mjs-changed` is either consumed by a job or removed.
- [ ] Behaviour on pull requests is unchanged.

Related: `ff38e2ab` (the commit that surfaced this), #842 (the experiments it added).
